original_submission.content:
import sys, shlex, subprocess
SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'
cmd = f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_ks_beta_bootstrap.py {SPEC} 1000 0 0"
if __name__ == "__main__":
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("RUN_KS_BETA_BOOTSTRAP_NONPARAM_RC", rc)
